summary: ```markdown # Clo 2025.0 Features Highlights Hey everyone! Clo 2025.0 is all about making your design process magical, harnessing AI so you can focus on the creative while we handle the mundane. Let's dive into our biggest updates! ## Key Features ### AI Pose Generator Our beta AI pose generator will automatically create dynamic poses for you, making the time-consuming work of creating poses obsolete. You'll be able to use either Clo's updated prompt system to generate poses closer to your ideas, or you can bring in your own images. Once your pose is created, you can easily save it and then apply that pose to any of your Clo projects. ### Enhanced Pattern Drafter Our pattern drafter takes parametric design a step further. Now you are able to create a range of shirt styles using our patented measurement technique. Simply type in your measurements, and Clo will guide you on where and how that measurement will adjust a pattern. Once you have a pattern you like, simply select "Create," and Clo will generate a range for you. ### AI Pattern Drafter We didn't stop there! Using our beta AI pattern drafter, you can start with just a sketch. Either have Clo generate a sketch from our prompt tools, or you can upload your own sketches, and Clo will generate the measurements for you. Using our Measurements section, you can continue to adjust and design further. Once ready, simply select "Create," and Clo will arrange and sew your design just like magic. ## Animation Editor UI Our Animation Editor UI has been updated to now include keyframes. These keyframes will allow for quick editing within animation, along with a range of editing options to choose from. You'll now have the ability to activate or deactivate numerous assets within Clo, ranging anywhere from gravity to colorway, making it possible to create exciting and powerful new animations. ### Fur Visualization You will now be able to see fur within your 3D window, allowing you to make more decisions within the 3D window instead of needing to go into your render window. Simply switch to "Fur Strand Type" within our Materials section, and you'll be able to see your fur immediately. This will also show up in the render window. ## Print Layout and Production Workflows Print Layout has received a significant upgrade, and so have your production workflows. With our new texture nesting, we can now read and follow the placement of your textures within the 3D window, ensuring that the placement is followed when nesting out the pattern. Simply select the pattern matching, and depending on the type of texture application, select either Print or Lock. You can see through these examples how this can impact a range of production categories and unlock many more production workflows within Clo. ## Avatars and AI Studio Upgrades AI Studio has been upgraded to include a background option, while also improving the overall output of images. Once opened, you can adjust either the avatar or the background. You can utilize our prompts by either using keywords or writing in what you're thinking to create the images. If you have an image already, you can simply upload that image into our studio, and it will rework the image to create the desired environment for your garment. ### Avatar Customization For our hip customization, you can now control the shaping of the hips, deciding how they should dip in or out of the body, and also control the bottom of the avatar, whether it should be round or flat. For breasts, you now have the option of adding in cup sizes. You can use your own breast cup sizes or the default cup sizes provided. ## 3D Window Updates Our UV has become an editor and moved under our materials and UV toolbar. You can also export out the back or side of your textures within the UV editor for better compatibility outside of Clo. ## Rendering Updates We have added options to choose your colorways within the 3D snapshot. This will work for both our single snapshot or our multi-snapshot. You can choose to select all the colorways or just specific ones, allowing you to quickly export multiple colorways of your project all at once. ### Depth of Field Control You now have more control within our render window and custom views. You can control the depth of field through each custom view by using the left-click to find your focus point, and Clo will automatically apply it to the custom view. ## Trim Improvements Attaching trims within Clo is easier than ever. Utilizing the tack tool for our trims, you can create multiple attachment points on a single trim. Select the tack tool, click on it or the layer tool to start the attachment process. ## Simulation Updates We have added another option to our 3D selection tool called "Advanced Pinching," which will allow control over what and how much you are selecting. Using the sliders, you can control how much you are selecting, and with the checkboxes, you can decide which patterns should be affected. ## User Interface Enhancements Now when bringing in a project file, you can choose if you want the toggle menu within that project file to open or if you want the default toggle menu to be used. We have added a new library window within Clo, making it even easier to use. ### Material Library Updates The new library is now open, and you can see the same library tools have been added into Clo's colorways. Using the shortcut key "O," you can open up the colorway editor and cycle through the color chips to see the different colorways. ## Grading and DXFs We have made annotations within Clo even easier to edit. You can now change color, size, edit the text, and rotate the annotation, all within the 2D window. ## 2D CAD Enhancements Our smooth curve tool has become more powerful than ever. With the ability to use the tool in the original method, we also included a new method involving curve points, giving you more control over editing your curves without affecting other parts of the pattern. ## Conclusion There are many more features that we have worked on and are included within this release, elevating your editing capabilities to a whole new level. Here are just a few more exciting features to mention. Thanks for watching! Stay tuned for our upcoming deep dives where you'll learn all about the new features. If you have any questions, drop them in the comments section below. Happy creating! ```
